goal: Build a cascading domino course that knocks a ball down a ramp and into a goal cup.
notes: Recorded from a live Gemini run (2026-10-25). Quick-start presets replay it instantly instead of building live.

steps.diagnosis: Built a complete cascading domino course level with a starter platform, an interactive overhead starter gong block, 12 rainbow-colored dominoes on a descending stepped terrace, a ball launch saddle holding targetBall, a low-friction ramp with guide rails, and a goal cup with a tall containment backstop.
